claim: Splash telemetry labels splash hide timing as time-to-interactive
suspected mechanism: app reports elapsed performance clock after hide rather than first successful input
discriminating experiment: mark first input/visible-correct milestone and compare with current event
alternative explanations: hide may be near readiness; analytics only; no user cost yet

claim: Dashboard replay emission persists JSON snapshots on every source emission
suspected mechanism: combineLatest tap serializes dashboard data to synchronous MMKV per emission
cost-model factors: emission frequency; data cardinality; serialization cost; JS critical path
discriminating experiment: measure emissions and JSON/MMKV duration while holding dataset constant; suppress tap isolation
alternative explanations: async persistence may be off interaction path; data may be small; cache can be intentional

claim: Reactive prewarm duplicates dashboard/account work before/around first interaction
suspected mechanism: Promise.allSettled subscribes to two shared streams during bootstrap and may overlap mount/hydration
column11: streams may share cache and complete before UI; native DB async may not contend

claim: Logger serializes and buffers performance context on hot paths
suspected mechanism: JSON.stringify/context and console buffering run for every log/metric
discriminating experiment: release-like build with telemetry/log paths off/on and trace markers
alternative explanations: production metric logs may be disabled; logging may be rare

claim: Trace timing uses wall-clock Date.now for causal segments
suspected mechanism: clock resolution/adjustment makes subsegments and cross-layer timing unreliable
cost-model factors: measurement integrity; cannot prove runtime cost
discriminating experiment: replace only in audit instrumentation or compare monotonic marks
alternative explanations: does not itself cause user cost; metrics could be coarse but usable

claim: Dashboard/account observers materialize and transform broad datasets
suspected mechanism: shared observable maps model collections to plain arrays/balance maps per emission
discriminating experiment: profile emissions/rows/transform/commit at justified typical/large seeds; narrow observer isolation
alternative explanations: SQL/query may dominate; compiler may make renders cheap

claim: Import/export JSON serialization creates a peak proportional to full payload
suspected mechanism: canonicalization/stringify/zip/backup duplicates large data in JS/native memory
discriminating experiment: synthetic fixture size sweep with process/native/JS memory and duration
alternative explanations: streaming/native exporter may bound some paths; fixture realism unknown

claim: Foreground maintenance competes with resume and first interaction
suspected mechanism: integrity/rebuild/widget/analytics tasks run after AppState active
discriminating experiment: trace resume plus first tap with tasks individually disabled
alternative explanations: work may be deferred/cancelled and not overlap; no runtime evidence yet

claim: SMS/AI native workloads cannot be assigned latency/memory findings from JS source
suspected mechanism: native execution/thread/memory/thermal behavior outside local static evidence
cost-model factors: call frequency; payload; native allocation; device class
discriminating experiment: physical Android/iOS profile with synthetic inputs and native traces
alternative explanations: JS boundary may still be material; platform support differs

claim: Bulk journal entry mounts an uncapped row tree in ScrollView
suspected mechanism: user-controlled row count maps every controlled row and each edit copies/scans the full rows array
cost-model factors: row count; field count; edit frequency; layout/memory
discriminating experiment: release Android/iOS at 10/50/100/250 rows with commit/frame/input/memory traces
alternative explanations: small forms may remain bounded in practice; no cap/measurement yet

claim: Bar chart scroll state re-renders the full SVG at 16 ms cadence

cost-model factors: scroll rate; point count; series count; SVG nodes; JS/UI contention
discriminating experiment: release Hermes fling at 30/90/180 points and 1/2 series with JS/UI traces
alternative explanations: chart may remain below frame budget; no trace yet

claim: Account-tree drag sends every gesture update through JS
suspected mechanism: runOnJS calls updateDrag which computes hover/auto-scroll and state
cost-model factors: gesture rate; row count; edge-scroll duration; hover changes
discriminating experiment: release Hermes drag at 20/100/300 rows with and without edge-scroll
alternative explanations: Reanimated transform may hide cost; static path remains JS-bound

claim: Safe-to-Spend projection retains one account map per simulation day
suspected mechanism: simulator clones roundedAccountBalances for each day and budget/recurrence generators scale with horizon
cost-model factors: days; accounts; budgets; scopes; cycles; emissions
discriminating experiment: synthetic D=30/90/180 and account/budget cardinality sweep with heap and duration
alternative explanations: downstream may discard data; runtime peak unknown

claim: Startup stabilization starts unrelated work concurrently after delay
suspected mechanism: integrity/insights/planned payments/sharing/exchange rates/notifications/SMS run in Promise.allSettled after interactions
discriminating experiment: release resume/first-tap traces with each task suppressed one at a time

claim: Export retains full tables plus JSON ZIP and Base64 representations
cost-model factors: rows; bytes; copies; peak memory; compression
discriminating experiment: synthetic export row sweep with JS/native RSS and per-stage bytes
